title: APIs, telemetry & evidence
outcome: Combine interface-independent collection with honest, testable conclusions.

steps.title: 1. Separate transport and meaning
steps.text: These drills use injected fake callables, never real equipment. A collector obtains data; a normalizer shapes it; a validator compares it with intended requirements. Reuse the same analysis with files, SSH or HTTP later.

steps.title: 2. Recognize unsuccessful collection
steps.text: No response is not proof of health. Preserve error categories and missing fields. An HTTP JSON response is not necessarily a successful HTTP operation.

steps.title: 3. Bound pagination and retries
steps.text: A page cursor can repeat, and remote services can fail. Detect cycles and cap work. Tests provide deterministic fake pages so you can inspect exact call order.

steps.title: 4. Preserve units and time
steps.text: Normalize timestamps into UTC and units into an explicit common scale. Do not combine incomparable metrics or label an old measurement current.

steps.title: 5. Intent is not observation
steps.text: Compare expected state with observed state without overwriting the approved expectation. Produce evidence references and a distinct UNKNOWN state when collection is incomplete. Configuration changes belong in an explicitly authorized lab project.

tasks.title: Decode an API envelope
contract: Define unwrap(response). response is {status:int,body:any}. Return body only for 200, otherwise raise ValueError.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: decode an api envelope.
Check the HTTP-style status before returning the body; having a body is not success.
Compare the implementation with case 03-empty body. Trace the supplied inputs and the exact return/output type before changing the code.

tasks.title: Paginated fake API
contract: Define pages(fetch). Start cursor None; fetch(cursor) returns {items:list,next:cursor_or_None}. Stop when next is None.
Return concatenated items. These fixtures are acyclic; cycle handling comes next.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: paginated fake api.
Keep requesting with the next cursor until the response explicitly ends pagination.
Compare the implementation with case 02-empty. Trace the supplied inputs and the exact return/output type before changing the code.

tasks.title: Reject a pagination cycle
contract: Define safe_pages(fetch,max_pages=10). Like pages, but raise ValueError before requesting a previously used cursor again or exceeding max_pages.
max_pages is a positive int. Return items on normal completion; do not silently return incomplete data.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: reject a pagination cycle.
Remember every cursor already requested and stop before repeating one or exceeding the budget.

tasks.title: Normalize timestamp to UTC
contract: Define utc(text). Parse an offset-aware ISO timestamp and return UTC isoformat using +00:00. Naive timestamps raise ValueError.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: normalize timestamp to utc.
An offset-aware timestamp carries timezone context; a naive timestamp cannot be safely assumed to be UTC.

tasks.title: Three-state compliance
contract: Define assess(expected,observed). expected is dict; observed is dict or None.
If observed is None, return UNKNOWN for every expected key. Otherwise absent keys UNKNOWN, matching values PASS, other values FAIL. Ignore extra observed keys.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: three-state compliance.
Absent evidence should produce UNKNOWN, not PASS; compare only after the observation is available.

tasks.title: TTL cache with an injected clock
tasks.brief: Do not re-fetch a fresh observation.
contract: Define cached(key,now,ttl,cache,fetch). cache maps key to {at,value}. now is numeric time, ttl>=0.
Reuse entry exactly when 0<=now-at<ttl; otherwise fetch(key), update cache and return value. A cached None is valid.

tasks.title: Validate before changing fake state
contract: Define apply(plan,approved,writer). plan is a list of {device,command}. If not approved, return 0 without calling writer.
If approved, call writer(device,command) for each item in order and return count. Exceptions propagate; do not pretend a partial failure completed. No real devices.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: validate before changing fake state.
Validate the whole plan before invoking the injected writer; a later bad row must not leave an earlier partial change.

tasks.title: Verification after an action
tasks.brief: Do not confuse execution with success.
contract: Define execute_verify(action,verify). Call action once, then verify once. Return PASS if verify() is exactly True, FAIL if exactly False, UNKNOWN if None.
action and verify exceptions propagate. They are fake callables.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: verification after an action.
Separate action errors from verification outcomes and keep None distinct from False.

Return records {name,state} for all expected names: UNKNOWN if absent/None, PASS for latency<=limit, FAIL otherwise. Ignore extra observations.
